detail: no MetadataOptions block: a launch configuration is immutable, so the ASG using it keeps minting IMDSv1 instances until it moves to a launch template
no MetadataOptions block: every instance this version launches answers IMDSv1, so fixing the live instances alone is undone by the next scale-out (1 collected instance(s) from this template)
HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2: the metadata response survives an extra network hop, so containers on a bridge network can reach the node role
HttpPutResponseHopLimit=3: new instances start with the extra hop already allowed
HttpEndpoint=enabled with no instance profile attached: nothing on the box needs IMDS, so the endpoint is pure attack surface
remediation: aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options --region eu-central-1 --instance-id i-0noro1e000000001a --http-endpoint disabled
